answer.rationale: Roll out the confirmed shorter onboarding flow: it improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue without creating a discount-dependent cohort. Do not broadly counter the competitor with promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment lifted signup and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%. This does not directly prove reduced churn among existing price-sensitive accounts, so monitor churn and cohort quality closely.
